promises.promise: Carry out the largest deportation operation in American history
promises.made_where: 2024 Republican Party platform (adopted at the Republican National Convention); one of its 20 core promises
promises.status_note: PolitiFact rates it In the Works (Sept. 8, 2026): ICE said more than 356,000 people had been deported in FY2026 as of July, less than half of the 1 million a year Trump promised.

promises.promise: Complete the border wall with Mexico
promises.made_where: 2024 Republican Party platform (adopted at the Republican National Convention)
promises.status_note: PolitiFact rates it In the Works (June 25, 2026): CBP has awarded 11 contracts covering 218 miles and reports 110 miles of barriers built, including 74 miles of primary wall. The stated goal is to close the border by FY2028.

promises.promise: Sign a Day One executive order ending automatic citizenship for U.S.-born children of parents in the country illegally
promises.made_where: Agenda47 campaign video/post (archived campaign page)
promises.status_note: Trump signed the order on Jan. 20, 2025, but on June 30, 2026 the Supreme Court struck it down in Trump v. Barbara. PolitiFact rates the promise Broken.

promises.promise: Restore and expand the first-term travel ban
promises.made_where: Campaign speech in Clive, Iowa (reported by NBC News)
promises.status_note: PolitiFact rates it Kept (Mar. 6, 2026): June 2025 restrictions fully covered 12 countries and partially covered 7. The ban was expanded again in December 2025.

promises.promise: Revoke Temporary Protected Status for Haitian migrants (e.g., in Springfield, Ohio) and send them back
promises.made_where: NewsNation interview (reported by CNN)
promises.status_note: In Mullin v. Doe (June 25, 2026, 6-3), the Supreme Court let DHS end Haiti's TPS designation. PolitiFact moved the promise from Stalled back to In the Works.

promises.promise: Automatically give green cards to foreign students who graduate from U.S. colleges
promises.made_where: All-In podcast interview (reported by ABC News)
promises.status_note: PolitiFact rates it Stalled (Jan. 30, 2026): there was no progress, and the administration instead moved to restrict post-graduation routes such as OPT and H-1B.

promises.promise: Designate the major drug cartels as foreign terrorist organizations
promises.made_where: Agenda47 video 'Declares War on Cartels' (archived campaign page, dated Dec. 22, 2023)
promises.status_note: On Feb. 20, 2025 the State Department designated six Mexican cartels, plus Tren de Aragua and MS-13, as FTOs. PolitiFact rates it Kept.

promises.promise: Impose a universal baseline tariff of about 10% (up to 20%) on all imported goods
promises.made_where: Fox Business interview: 'let's say a 10% tax' (reported by Business Insider, Aug. 22, 2023)
promises.status_note: After the Supreme Court struck down the IEEPA tariffs (Learning Resources v. Trump, 6-3), PolitiFact rated it In the Works on Feb. 20, 2026. Per CRS (Oct. 8, 2026), a Section 122 10% global tariff expired July 24, 2026 and was followed by Section 301 tariffs of 10% to 12.5% on 60 economies (see https://www.everycrsreport.com/reports/R49481.html).

promises.promise: Impose tariffs of 60% (or more) on goods from China
promises.made_where: Fox News 'Sunday Morning Futures' interview (reported by CNN)
promises.status_note: Trump went past 60% in April 2025 (145%). The Feb. 2026 Supreme Court ruling then invalidated the IEEPA-based China tariffs. PolitiFact rates it In the Works because Section 301/232 tools remain, though a 60% rate is uncertain.

promises.promise: Institute reciprocal tariffs (pass the Trump Reciprocal Trade Act)
promises.made_where: 2024 Republican Party platform (adopted at the Republican National Convention)
promises.status_note: PolitiFact rates it Stalled (Feb. 20, 2026): the Supreme Court struck down the IEEPA-based 'reciprocal' tariffs, and Congress has not passed a Reciprocal Trade Act.

promises.promise: Make the Trump tax cuts permanent: a 'middle-class, upper-class, lower-class, business-class big tax cut'
promises.made_where: 2024 Republican Party platform (adopted at the Republican National Convention) ('Make Trump Tax Cuts Permanent')
promises.status_note: The One Big Beautiful Bill Act, signed July 4, 2025, extended the 2017 tax law and added new cuts. The Tax Policy Center found after-tax income rises in every income group, with larger gains at the top. PolitiFact rates it Kept.

promises.promise: No tax on tips
promises.made_where: Campaign rally in Las Vegas, Nevada (reported by CNN)
promises.status_note: The July 2025 law lets eligible workers deduct up to $25,000 in tips (with income limits) through 2028. PolitiFact rates it Kept.

promises.promise: End all taxes on overtime pay
promises.made_where: Campaign rally in Tucson, Arizona (reported by NBC News)
promises.status_note: PolitiFact rates it Compromise: the law allows a deduction through 2028 of up to $12,500 (single) or $25,000 (joint), and only for the premium 'half' of FLSA overtime pay.

promises.promise: End taxes on Social Security benefits ('Seniors should not pay tax on Social Security')
promises.made_where: Truth Social post (reported by Roll Call)
promises.status_note: PolitiFact rates it Compromise: the July 2025 law did not end taxation of benefits. It added a temporary $6,000 deduction for people 65 and older, through 2028.

promises.promise: Restore the state and local tax (SALT) deduction ('get SALT back')
promises.made_where: Truth Social post before a Uniondale, N.Y. rally (reported by NBC News)
promises.status_note: PolitiFact rates it Compromise: the cap rose temporarily to $40,000 and returns to $10,000 in 2030.

promises.promise: Make interest on car loans tax-deductible
promises.made_where: Speech to the Detroit Economic Club (reported by CNBC)
promises.status_note: The July 2025 law lets buyers deduct up to $10,000 a year in interest on new U.S.-assembled vehicles for 2025-2028. PolitiFact rates it Kept.

promises.promise: Cut the corporate tax rate from 21% to 15% for companies that make their products in America
promises.made_where: Speech to the Economic Club of New York (official transcript)
promises.status_note: PolitiFact rates it Stalled: the 2025 tax law expanded expensing benefits for businesses but did not lower the corporate rate to 15%.

promises.promise: Defeat inflation and quickly bring down prices (groceries, cars, other consumer goods)
promises.made_where: 2024 Republican Party platform (adopted at the Republican National Convention) (core promise: 'End inflation, and make America affordable again')
promises.status_note: PolitiFact rates it Stalled (Jan. 20, 2026): year-over-year inflation went only from 3.0% to 2.7%. Prices for groceries, electricity, housing and medical care kept rising.

promises.promise: Cut energy costs in half within 12 months of taking office
promises.made_where: Campaign rally in Potterville, Michigan (Rev transcript)
promises.status_note: PolitiFact rates it Stalled (Jan. 20, 2026): at the one-year mark gasoline was down about 11%, but electricity was up almost 7% and natural gas almost 9%.

promises.promise: Get gasoline below $2 a gallon
promises.made_where: Speech to the Economic Club of New York (official transcript)
promises.status_note: PolitiFact rates it Stalled: the national average was $4.15 a gallon on Apr. 10, 2026 after the Iran war disrupted shipping through the Strait of Hormuz.

promises.promise: Put a temporary cap of about 10% on credit card interest rates
promises.made_where: Campaign rally in Uniondale, New York (Rev transcript)
promises.status_note: PolitiFact rates it Stalled: Trump publicly called for a 10% cap in January 2026, but legislation has not advanced and no cap is in effect.

promises.promise: Immediately refill the Strategic Petroleum Reserve
promises.made_where: Campaign pledge reported by E&E News (POLITICO)
promises.status_note: PolitiFact rates it Stalled (Sept. 4, 2026): after releases during the Iran war, the reserve is at its lowest level since the early 1980s, about 26% below where it was when he took office.

promises.promise: End offshore wind energy development 'on day one' by executive order
promises.made_where: Campaign rally in Wildwood, New Jersey (reported by The Guardian)
promises.status_note: PolitiFact rates it In the Works: Trump signed a Day One order on Jan. 20, 2025, but in December 2025 courts ruled the halt unlawful and paused projects resumed.

promises.promise: Approve liquefied natural gas (LNG) export terminals on his first day back
promises.made_where: Campaign promise compiled in PolitiFact's list of Trump's 2024 promises (published Sept. 30, 2024); original statement date not independently verified
promises.status_note: PolitiFact rated it In the Works (Jan. 23, 2025; its latest update): the Biden-era pause on new LNG export approvals was lifted Jan. 21, 2025, but no new terminals were approved right away.

promises.promise: Withdraw the U.S. from the Paris climate agreement (again)
promises.made_where: Campaign promise compiled in PolitiFact's list of Trump's 2024 promises (published Sept. 30, 2024); original statement date not independently verified
promises.status_note: Trump signed an executive order on Jan. 20, 2025 withdrawing from the Paris Agreement. PolitiFact rates it Kept.

promises.promise: End the Russia-Ukraine war within 24 hours (before even taking office)
promises.made_where: CNN town hall in New Hampshire (repeated through 2024, including the Sept. 2024 debate)
promises.status_note: PolitiFact rates it Broken: the war continued past the deadline with no peace deal. As of Oct. 21, 2026, Reuters reports U.S.-brokered trilateral talks are only being revived (see https://www.arabnews.com/world/ukraines-zelensky-says-he-supports-ceasefire-trilateral-talks-with-us-russia-3007519).

promises.promise: Build an Iron Dome missile defense shield over the entire country, made in America
promises.made_where: 2024 Republican Party platform (adopted at the Republican National Convention) (core promise)
promises.status_note: PolitiFact rates it In the Works: the July 2025 law included $24.4 billion for 'Golden Dome,' a fraction of the roughly $175 billion Trump estimated.

promises.promise: Withdraw from the World Health Organization
promises.made_where: Campaign promise compiled in PolitiFact's list of Trump's 2024 promises (published Sept. 30, 2024); original statement date not independently verified
promises.status_note: Trump ordered withdrawal on Jan. 20, 2025, and the U.S. exit was completed in January 2026. PolitiFact rates it Kept.

promises.promise: Protect Social Security and Medicare with no cuts, including no change to the retirement age
promises.made_where: 2024 Republican Party platform (adopted at the Republican National Convention) (core promise)
promises.status_note: PolitiFact rates it In the Works (Feb. 19, 2026): there have been no direct benefit cuts. However, SSA staffing cuts and the 2025 law's end of Medicare eligibility for some lawfully present immigrants could affect beneficiaries.

promises.promise: Have the government pay for, or mandate insurers to cover, IVF treatment
promises.made_where: Campaign interview with NBC News
promises.status_note: PolitiFact rates it In the Works after a Feb. 18, 2025 executive order on IVF access. CNN (May 21, 2026) reports there is no coverage mandate; the administration has offered TrumpRx drug discounts and proposed a rule for voluntary employer fertility benefits (https://www.cnn.com/2026/05/21/politics/ivf-treatment-cost-trump).

promises.promise: Close the Department of Education and send education back to the states
promises.made_where: 2024 Republican Party platform (adopted at the Republican National Convention)
promises.status_note: PolitiFact rates it In the Works (June 26, 2026): functions are being moved to other agencies (e.g., Treasury, Justice, HHS), but Congress has not abolished the department.

promises.promise: Universal school choice in every state
promises.made_where: 2024 Republican Party platform (adopted at the Republican National Convention)
promises.status_note: PolitiFact rates it In the Works: the July 2025 law created a federal tax credit for scholarship donations starting in 2027. States must opt in, so school choice is not universal.

promises.promise: Pardon/free people convicted over the Jan. 6, 2021 Capitol riot as one of his first acts
promises.made_where: Campaign remarks reported by NBC News
promises.status_note: On Jan. 20, 2025 Trump issued a proclamation pardoning Jan. 6 defendants and commuting 14 sentences. PolitiFact rates it Kept.

promises.promise: On Day One, commute the life sentence of Silk Road operator Ross Ulbricht
promises.made_where: Libertarian National Convention speech (reported by NBC News)
promises.status_note: Trump went further and granted Ulbricht a full pardon on Jan. 21, 2025. PolitiFact rates it Kept.

promises.promise: 'Save TikTok' from a U.S. ban
promises.made_where: Remarks to reporters while campaigning in Philadelphia (reported by the Los Angeles Times)
promises.status_note: A U.S. joint venture keeping TikTok operating in the U.S. was announced Jan. 22, 2026. PolitiFact rates it Kept.

promises.promise: Create a Government Efficiency Commission (led by Elon Musk) to audit government and eliminate fraud and improper payments
promises.made_where: Speech to the Economic Club of New York (official transcript)
promises.status_note: PolitiFact's latest update (June 2025) rated it In the Works: DOGE claimed $180 billion in savings, but verifiable itemized cuts were roughly half that. DOGE's mandate ran to July 4, 2026, and PolitiFact has not published a final rating.

promises.promise: On Day One, re-issue the Schedule F order restoring the president's power to fire 'rogue bureaucrats'
promises.made_where: Agenda47 video 'Plan to Dismantle the Deep State' (campaign page copy in House committee records)
promises.status_note: PolitiFact rates it Kept: OPM issued a final 'Schedule Policy/Career' rule on Feb. 5, 2026 covering about 50,000 positions, effective Mar. 9, 2026, with litigation pending.

promises.promise: Cut off federal funding for NPR ('NOT ONE DOLLAR')
promises.made_where: Truth Social post (reported by CNN)
promises.status_note: On July 18, 2025 Congress approved a rescissions package that canceled about $1.07 billion for the Corporation for Public Broadcasting, which funds NPR and PBS. PolitiFact rates it Kept.

promises.promise: Require voter ID
promises.made_where: 2024 Republican Party platform (adopted at the Republican National Convention) (core promise: 'Secure our elections, including ... voter identification')
promises.status_note: PolitiFact rates it Broken: the Senate rejected a national photo-ID bill 52-46 on Aug. 8, 2026, short of the 60 votes needed, so the midterms will follow state ID laws.

promises.promise: Require proof of citizenship to vote
promises.made_where: 2024 Republican Party platform (adopted at the Republican National Convention) (core promise)
promises.status_note: PolitiFact rates it Stalled: the House passed the SAVE America Act on Feb. 11, 2026, but it faces Senate hurdles, and courts blocked key parts of a related executive order.

promises.promise: Require paper ballots
promises.made_where: 2024 Republican Party platform (adopted at the Republican National Convention) (core promise)
promises.status_note: PolitiFact rates it Stalled (Jan. 21, 2026): no concrete federal steps have been taken and Congress has not acted.

promises.promise: Count all votes on election night
promises.made_where: Campaign promise compiled in PolitiFact's list of Trump's 2024 promises (published Sept. 30, 2024); original statement date not independently verified
promises.status_note: PolitiFact rates it Broken (June 29, 2026): in Watson v. RNC (5-4), the Supreme Court upheld states' counting of mail ballots postmarked by Election Day but received later.

promises.promise: Reinstate the ban on transgender people serving in the military
promises.made_where: Campaign promise compiled in PolitiFact's list of Trump's 2024 promises (published Sept. 30, 2024); original statement date not independently verified
promises.status_note: The ban was implemented after the Supreme Court allowed it to take effect on May 6, 2025. PolitiFact rates it Kept.

promises.promise: Ask Congress to pass a law recognizing only two genders, male and female, assigned at birth
promises.made_where: Agenda47 video 'Plan to Protect Children from Left-Wing Gender Insanity' (archived campaign page)
promises.status_note: A Jan. 20, 2025 executive order declared that federal policy recognizes two sexes, but Congress has not passed such a law. PolitiFact rates it In the Works.

promises.promise: Pass a law banning gender-transition procedures for minors in all 50 states
promises.made_where: Agenda47 video 'Plan to Protect Children from Left-Wing Gender Insanity' (archived campaign page)
promises.status_note: PolitiFact rates it In the Works: HHS proposed rules on Dec. 18, 2025 targeting providers that perform these procedures on minors, and the House passed the Protect Children's Innocence Act, but no nationwide ban is law.

promises.promise: Create 'baby bonuses' for new parents
promises.made_where: Campaign promise compiled in PolitiFact's list of Trump's 2024 promises (published Sept. 30, 2024); original statement date not independently verified
promises.status_note: The July 2025 law provides a $1,000 federal deposit into a 'Trump account' for U.S.-citizen babies born 2025-2028. PolitiFact rates it Kept.
